personality_traits.description_zh: 以极其直率的沟通方式著称，几乎不会回避任何问题
personality_traits.description_en: Known for extremely direct communication, rarely avoids any question
personality_traits.quote_en: I don't filter what I say. I just say what I think is true.

personality_traits.description_zh: 善于使用幽默和讽刺来表达观点，尤其喜欢网络迷因和自嘲式幽默
personality_traits.description_en: Skilled at using humor and sarcasm to express views, especially fond of internet memes and self-deprecating humor
personality_traits.quote_en: I'm a huge fan of memes. Memes are basically the modern art.

personality_traits.description_zh: 以近乎疯狂的冒险精神闻名，曾三次将全部身家投入自己的公司
personality_traits.description_en: Known for near-insane risk-taking, has bet his entire fortune on his companies three times
personality_traits.quote_en: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.

personality_traits.description_zh: 将问题分解到最基本的真理，然后从那里重新构建解决方案
personality_traits.description_en: Breaks problems down to the most fundamental truths, then builds up solutions from there
personality_traits.quote_en: It's important to reason from first principles rather than by analogy. The normal way we conduct our lives is we reason by analogy.

personality_traits.description_zh: 以极端的工作强度著称，经常每周工作100-120小时
personality_traits.description_en: Known for extreme work intensity, often working 100-120 hours per week
personality_traits.quote_en: There were times when I didn't leave the factory for three or four days. I'd sleep on the floor, under the desk, or in a conference room.
personality_traits.quote_source: Elon Musk biography by Ashlee Vance

personality_traits.description_zh: 尽管面临无数挫折，始终对未来保持极度乐观的态度
personality_traits.description_en: Despite countless setbacks, maintains an extremely optimistic attitude about the future
personality_traits.quote_en: I think we have a duty to maintain the light of consciousness. We should do our best to ensure that there is enough light of consciousness to continue into the future.

personality_traits.description_zh: 经常故意发表挑衅性言论来引发讨论或测试反应
personality_traits.description_en: Often deliberately makes provocative statements to spark discussion or test reactions
personality_traits.quote_en: I'm not trying to be provocative. I'm just saying what I actually think.

recent_changes_2025_2026.description_zh: 2025年初接受特朗普邀请，领导新成立的政府效率部，推动联邦支出审查
recent_changes_2025_2026.description_en: Early 2025, accepted Trump's invitation to lead the newly formed Department of Government Efficiency, pushing federal spending review
key_milestones: 2025年2-3月：推动大规模联邦支出审查
2025年下半年：逐步退出日常管理，回归企业运营
recent_changes_2025_2026.quote_en: We're going to get government spending under control. There's so much waste and fraud.

recent_changes_2025_2026.event_zh: SpaceX 与 xAI 资源整合
recent_changes_2025_2026.description_zh: SpaceX和xAI在算力资源方面进行了深度整合
recent_changes_2025_2026.description_en: Deep integration of compute resources between SpaceX and xAI
recent_changes_2025_2026.quote_en: xAI and SpaceX are working closely together on compute infrastructure. It's a natural synergy.

recent_changes_2025_2026.description_zh: xAI持续发布Grok系列大语言模型
recent_changes_2025_2026.description_en: xAI continuously released Grok series large language models
key_milestones: Grok-3: 2025年底发布，多个基准测试中达到领先水平
Grok-4: 2026年初发布，进一步扩展推理能力
recent_changes_2025_2026.quote_en: Grok is designed to be maximally truth-seeking and minimally politically correct. That's what people actually want.

recent_changes_2025_2026.description_zh: Tesla的无人驾驶出租车服务正式上线运营
recent_changes_2025_2026.description_en: Tesla's autonomous ride-hailing service officially launched
recent_changes_2025_2026.quote_en: This is the most important product launch in Tesla's history. Robotaxi will transform transportation.

recent_changes_2025_2026.description_zh: 脑机接口临床试验取得重大进展，多名瘫痪患者成功通过意念控制电子设备
recent_changes_2025_2026.description_en: Major progress in BCI clinical trials, multiple paralyzed patients successfully controlled electronic devices through thought
recent_changes_2025_2026.quote_en: The Neuralink patients are doing remarkably well. They're able to control computers and devices just by thinking.

recent_changes_2025_2026.description_zh: Starship火箭取得多项里程碑，包括多次成功轨道飞行和回收
recent_changes_2025_2026.description_en: Starship rocket achieved multiple milestones including successful orbital flights and recoveries
key_milestones: 多次成功轨道飞行和回收
星际加油技术的在轨验证
为NASA Artemis月球任务做准备
火星无人货运任务的初步规划
recent_changes_2025_2026.quote_en: Starship is progressing faster than I expected. We could have uncrewed missions to Mars as early as 2029.

core_beliefs.quote_en: I think it's important that we become a multi-planet civilization. We don't want to be a single-planet species because eventually something will happen to Earth.
We have this light of consciousness. It's very rare in the universe as far as we can tell. We should try to expand and preserve it.
Free speech is the bedrock of a functioning democracy. X is the town square for free speech.
The fundamental challenge of our time is the transition to sustainable energy. Everything else is secondary.
The thing that I find most motivating is creating the future. I want to wake up in the morning and think the future is going to be great.
